decisions.reason: Having survived the first review and fitting tightly with the firm's market-data and analytics capabilities at low incremental cost, it remains a worthwhile option to keep while cross-selling and usage evidence continues to build.
This calculator is very close to the firm's core tariff, billing and calculation activities, so its strategic fit and likely integration value make continued retention the most likely choice.

Although somewhat more niche than the tariff calculators, the tool still leverages existing data and process know-how and is inexpensive enough to keep on the market while the firm evaluates further customer uptake.
